concept_gloss.applicability: Kan bedeli ve benzeri toplumsal yükleri topluluk adına üzerine alan önderler için tam karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişilerin ileri gelen olmasını, topluluk adına hareket etmesini ve ağır yükümlülüğü üstlenmesini korur.

concept_gloss.text: topluluğun ağır yükümlülüklerini üstlenen ileri gelenler

concept_map.definition: Topluluk adına kan bedellerini ve başka ağır mali yükümlülükleri üstlenip taşıyan ileri gelenlerdir. Adlandırma, onların bu yükü topluluk üzerinden almasına dayanan yük taşıma benzetisiyle açıklanır.

facets.statement: Topluluğun ileri gelenlerinin kan bedeli ve ağır yükümlülükleri topluluk adına üstlenmesi temel anlamdır.
Kişilerin adlandırılması, ağır yük taşıyan hayvana benzetilerek açıklanır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Özellikle öldürme veya yaralama karşılığındaki mali yükün topluluk adına karşılandığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Kan bedeli dışındaki başka ağır toplumsal yükümlülükleri kapsamaz.
error_profile.preserves: Önderlerin topluluk adına kan bedelini üstlenmesi çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.text: topluluk adına kan bedelini üstlenen önderler

error_profile.adds: Ağır mali yükümlülük üstlenmeyen her türlü başkan ve yönetici rolünü ekler.
error_profile.collision: Genel yönetim makamıyla toplumsal borç taşıyıcılığı karışır.
error_profile.preserves: Topluluğun ileri gelen veya yönetici kişileri olma yönünü korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal herhangi bir yönetici değil, topluluğun ağır mali ve toplumsal yükünü fiilen üstlenen ileri gelenlerdir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, topluluk adına kan bedellerini ve ağır yükümlülükleri üstlenen ileri gelenleri açıkça tanımlar ve adlandırmayı yük taşıyan hayvana benzetmeyle açıklar. Dal çerçevesi kişi rolünü ve taşınan toplumsal yükü doğru korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: topluluk adına kan bedeli ve ağır yükümlülükleri üstlenen ileri gelenler

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın çoğul kişi adını korur ve benzetmeyi su taşıyan hayvanın ayrı sözlük anlamıyla birleştirmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sekiz dış aday ve on dört kardeş dalın tamamı değerlendirildi; kişiyi yükümlülük kurumundan ve genel toplumsal dayanaktan ayıran iki aday seçildi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bu işi yapan toplumsal önderleri adlandırır; komşu dal kişinin statüsünden bağımsız olarak üstlenme ve güvence ilişkisini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yükümlülüğü üstlenen kişileri topluluğun ileri gelenleri olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kan bedeli, para cezası, kefillik ve güvence verme eylem veya kurumlarını genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kan bedeli veya başka mali yükün bir başkası adına üstlenilmesi iki dalın ortak alanıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı ölçütü belirli ağır mali yükleri üstlenmektir; komşu dal daha genel destek, güvence ve koruyuculuk rolündedir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kan bedeli ve ağır yükümlülükleri fiilen üzerine alma koşulunu taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aile veya topluluğun genel dayanağı, güvenilir desteği ve zor zamanda koruyucusu olmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da topluluğun zor durumda güvendiği güçlü ve ileri gelen kişileri anlatır.

root_profile.summary: Kök, suya kanma ve su taşıma çevresinden söz aktarma, düşünerek değerlendirme, ihtiyaç, kalan miktar, yük bağı, yapı bağımlı dolgunluk, görünüş, koku, hayvan, bayrak, uyak harfi, yağmur bulutu ve toplumsal yük taşıyan önderlere uzanan çok sayıda bağımsız dal içerir. Dalların bir bölümü su, taşıma ve doluluk benzetileriyle tarihsel olarak ilişkilendirilebilse de çağdaş kavram haritasında ayrı sınırlar gerektirir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir varlığın serbestçe hareket etmesini veya bırakılmasını engelleme alanında buluşur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kapalı tutma, kişinin bir yerde özgürlüğünden yoksun bırakılmasıdır; bağa vurma ise bunu sağlayabilen belirli bir araçlı işlemdir ve kapalı bir yer gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalında kapalı tutma veya kapatılma yeri vardır; bağ kullanılması zorunlu değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin hareket imkanını ortadan kaldıran bir kısıtlama durumunu anlatır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca kanıtta verilen darbe söz öbeğinin birleşik anlamını eksiksiz açıklamak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Darbenin şiddetini veya kalıcı etkisini ve vurulanı tutulmuş gibi sabit bırakmasını korur.

concept_gloss.text: vurulanı sabit bırakan şiddetli ya da etkisi kalıcı darbe

concept_map.definition: Yalnızca belirli darbe söz öbeğinde, şiddeti ya da süren etkisi vurulan kişiyi tutulmuş gibi sabit bırakan darbeyi anlatır. Aktarılan bir yorum, metinde başka bir sözcüğün amaçlanmış olabileceğini belirtir.

facets.statement: Belirli söz öbeğinde çok şiddetli veya etkisi kalıcı olan darbe.
Darbenin vurulan kişiyi tutulmuş gibi yerinden kıpırdayamaz durumda bırakması.
Aktarılan bir yorumda, metindeki biçimin yerine başka bir sözcüğün amaçlanmış olabileceği çekincesi.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlamın yalnızca darbenin olağanüstü şiddetini öne çıkardığı akıcı çevirilerde kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Etkinin sürekliliğini ve vurulanı tutulmuş gibi sabit bırakma sonucunu açıkça vermez.
error_profile.preserves: Darbenin çok şiddetli oluşunu doğal Türkçe ile korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlamın darbenin vurulan kişi üzerindeki sabitleyici sonucunu öne çıkardığı yerde kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Darbenin şiddetli veya etkisi kalıcı diye nitelenmesini açıkça vermez.
error_profile.preserves: Vurulan kişinin tutulmuş gibi sabit kalması sonucunu korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca belirtilen darbe söz öbeğine aittir; genel bir vurma veya yalın bir kapatma anlamı olarak kullanılamaz.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir darbe söz öbeğinde şiddet, süreklilik ve vurulanı tutulmuş gibi sabit bırakma açıklamalarını destekler. Bununla birlikte aktarılan bir yorum, metinde başka bir sözcüğün amaçlanmış olabileceğini söylediği için dal bu okuma çekincesiyle kabul edilebilir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: vurulanı sabit bırakan şiddetli ya da etkisi kalıcı darbe

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kesin biçimde darbe söz öbeğine bağlıdır ve şiddetli ya da kalıcı etkiyi yalın kökün bağımsız anlamı saymaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Dokuz adayın tümü değerlendirildi; ezici baskı, deri sıyıran vuruş ve ana kapatma dalı sınırı açıklarken öteki vurma adayları yalnızca eylem alanını paylaşıp bu söz öbeğinin kalıcı sabitleme özelliğini taşımadı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak tek bir darbenin vurulan üzerindeki sabitleyici niteliğidir. Komşu ise basma, baskı, saldırı ve toplu hücum gibi olayları kapsar; bu yüzden söz öbekleri birbirinin yerine geçmez.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalı, belirli bir darbe söz öbeğinde vurulanı sabit bırakan şiddetli veya kalıcı etkiyi taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, düşmanın ezici basışı, baskısı, saldırısı veya ağır hücumu gibi daha geniş bir alanı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir kişi veya topluluk üzerinde ağır ve karşı koymayı güçleştiren fiziksel etkiyi anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta sonuç tutulmuş gibi sabit kalmaktır; komşuda ise derinin sıyrılmasıdır. Aynı vurma alanında bulunsalar da sonuç yapıları ayrıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalı darbenin şiddetini, süren etkisini ve vurulanı sabit bırakmasını belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: sabitleyen darbe ile deri sıyıran vuruş
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalın ayırt edici sonucu derinin darbeyle sıyrılması veya kazınmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da güçlü bir vurma olayını ve bu olayın vurulan üzerindeki sonucunu konu edinir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta kapalı tutma yalnızca darbenin etkisini açıklayan benzetmedir; komşuda ise eylemin doğrudan çekirdeği ve yer anlamının temelidir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalı gerçek bir darbenin şiddetini ve vurulan üzerindeki kalıcı, sabitleyici etkisini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal gerçek bir özgürlük kısıtlamasını ve kişinin kapalı tutulduğu yeri anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Darbe sonucu kişinin tutulmuş gibi kalması, iki dalı aynı kısıtlanma tasarımında buluşturur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kaynaklarda aynı ad için verilen üç ayrı göndergeyi birlikte ve karara bağlamadan göstermek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Cehennem, kötülerin kayıtlarının bulunduğu yer ve yedinci kat yer açıklamalarının üçünü de korur.

concept_gloss.text: cehennem, kötülerin kayıt yeri veya yedinci kat yer adı

facets.statement: Belirli adın cehennem için kullanılması.
Belirli adın kötülerin kayıtlarının veya kayıt defterlerinin bulunduğu yeri göstermesi.
Belirli adın yedinci kat yer için kullanılması.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlamın belirli adı doğrudan cehennem için kullandığı açıklamada tercih edilir.

error_profile.loses: Kötülerin kayıt yeri ve yedinci kat yer açıklamalarını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Belirli adın cehennemi göstermesi açıklamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlamın adı kötülerin kayıtları veya kayıt defterleriyle ilişkilendirdiği yerde kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Cehennem ve yedinci kat yer açıklamalarını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel bir yer, aşağılık veya kapatma anlamı değildir; yalnızca kaynaklarda üç farklı göndergesi bulunan belirli adlandırmadır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir genel altlık veya kapatma kavramı tanımlamaz; aynı belirli ad için cehennem, kötülerin kayıtlarının bulunduğu yer ve yedinci kat yer açıklamalarını yan yana verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak tanım bu farklı göndergeleri birleştirmeden kaynaklar arası değişkenlik olarak göstermelidir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: cehennem, kötülerin kayıtlarının bulunduğu yer veya yedinci kat yer için kullanılan ad

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca kanıtta verilen belirli adlandırmaya bağlıdır; bu kullanımdan yalın kök için genel bir yer veya kapatma anlamı çıkarılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Dokuz adayın tümü değerlendirildi; genel yer kavramı ve üstlük karşıtlığı sınırı aydınlattı. Dağ, tepe, çukur, sert zemin ve benzeri adaylar yalnızca yer alanını paylaştı; ana kapatma dalı ise kaynak ifadesindeki belirli adın göndergesini açıklamadı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak, kaynaklar arasında göndergesi değişen belirli bir addır; komşu ise herhangi bir yer veya konumu anlatan genel kavramdır. Bu nedenle özel kullanım genel yer anlamına açılamaz.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalı, kaynaklarda birkaç belirli göndergeye bağlanan tek bir adlandırmadır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel olarak yer, konum, mevki ve bir yerde bulunma imkanını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir yerin veya konumun dil yoluyla belirtilmesi alanında buluşur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak belirli bir aşağı alem adlandırmasıdır; komşu ise çok çeşitli nesnelerde üst, ön veya ilk kısmı anlatır. Karşıtlık yalnızca dikey konum eksenindedir, kapsamlar eş değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalında cehennem ve yedinci kat yer gibi aşağı alanla ilişkilendirilen belirli bir ad vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: aşağı alem adı ile üst ve ön konum
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyin önü, üstü, başı veya ilk kısmını anlatan genel yön ve sıra anlamlarını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kaynak anlatımındaki karşıtlık, belirli aşağı alan ile üstlük yönünü ortak bir konum ekseninde buluşturur.

Bir hurma gövdesini bu yerel adla belirtilen biçime veya duruma getirme işlemi.
Karşılık olarak verilen yerel sözcüğün kaynakta yabancı kökenli sayılması, fakat nesnesinin açıklanmaması.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün hurmayla ilgili yöresel adlandırma olarak geçtiği ve nesnenin ayrıca açıklanmadığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Hurma gövdesini bu adla belirtilen duruma getirme işlemini dışarıda bırakır.

error_profile.preserves: Hurma gövdesini kaynakta yerel adla belirtilen sonuca getirme işlemini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, hurmaya özgü yöresel ad ile gövde üzerinde yapılan bağlı işlemi kapsar; ortaya çıkan nesnenin türü kanıtın ötesinde belirlenemez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Bahreyn yöresinde hurmayla ilgili bir adlandırmayı ve bir hurma gövdesini bu adla belirtilen sonuca getirme söz öbeğini açıkça aktarır. Ancak karşılık olarak verilen yerel sözcüğün nesnesini veya ortaya çıkan biçimi açıklamadığı için dal ancak bu belirsizlik korunarak tanımlanabilir.

text.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَيَسْجُنُنَّهُۥ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ

baseline.text: Sonra, kanıtları görmelerinin ardından, onu bir süre hapsetmek onlara uygun göründü.

findings.text: Masumiyeti gösteren işaretler bilinmesine rağmen hapis kararı alınması, kurumun gerçeği aramak yerine bilinen gerçeğin doğuracağı skandalı yönetmesidir.
Belirsiz bırakılan süre, özgürlüğün takvimini de iktidarın eline vererek fiziksel hapsi zamansal denetime genişletir.

activation_trace.role: An arising new opinion makes the detention decision a reversal rather than the continuation of an settled judgment.
Sight and inward perception establish that the group has apprehended evidence rather than acting from simple ignorance.
A manifest mark supplies the visible evidence whose recognition immediately precedes the policy change.
Confinement in a holding place supplies the operational response to what has become visible.
A span of time limits the policy without naming a juridical endpoint, leaving it provisional.

changed_reading.after: The seeing itself generates a changed policy: evidence is converted from a truth-disclosing resource into a reason to contain its bearer.
changed_reading.before: They imprison him despite having seen some evidence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of a new appearance, prior seeing, plural signs, emphatic imprisonment, and a limited time.
baseline_models.mechanism: Acknowledged visible evidence does not prevent confinement; it precipitates a new collective policy that removes the evidenced person from circulation.

activation_trace.role: Temporal aftermath places the decision downstream of completed perception and makes delay part of the mechanism.
A newly arising opinion marks the pause as an improvised policy rather than a settled sentence.
The holding place becomes the material instrument for suspending resolution.
Waiting for the right time turns the unnamed duration into a strategy of deferral.
Assigning a time to an act suggests administrative timing even though the actual term remains undisclosed.

changed_reading.after: Prison functions as a waiting device: it postpones decision after the signs rather than resolving what the signs mean.
changed_reading.before: Until a time merely states the duration of a prison sentence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The double temporal framing, after and until a time, encloses the emphatic prison decision.
baseline_models.mechanism: The group does not announce a final verdict; it creates an institutional pause after evidence, waiting for an unnamed future condition before reconsideration.

activation_trace.role: Coercive narrowing makes the first enclosure an instrument for controlling access and movement.
The doorway supplies a boundary between imposed privacy and possible escape.
Racing ahead makes control of the boundary an active contest rather than a static setting.
The repeated threshold acts as the limit where private control breaks and evidence becomes externally visible.
Extraction from concealment reverses the closed-door scene into a controlled public display.
The prison holding place institutionalizes the enclosure that the household could not sustain privately.

changed_reading.after: Prison is the escalation of an existing control technology, replacing a penetrable private enclosure with an institutional one.
changed_reading.before: Prison is a new punitive location introduced at the end of the episode.

context_deltas.mechanism: A failed private architecture of coercion is scaled into an institutional one: sealed household doors, flight to the threshold, and staged emergence culminate in prison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the same body is successively enclosed, escapes toward a boundary, is displayed, and is imprisoned. Reader: prison is the public-scale replacement for failed private enclosure. Alternative: the prison may answer scandal or disobedience without intentionally repeating the house's spatial logic.
structural_cues: The sequence moves from doors sealed in 12:23, through a race to the repeated threshold in 12:25, to commanded public emergence in 12:31 and official confinement in 12:35.

activation_trace.role: A lengthwise tear supplies a directional material mark capable of testing the accusation.
Knowledge-based declaration converts the material mark into articulated evidence.
Established soundness gives the rear-tear inference a stable exculpatory result.
Direct inspection closes the gap between proposed test and acknowledged result.
Turning aside changes the household response from adjudicating the evidence to suppressing its continuation.
Protective covering activates scandal containment alongside the explicit moral demand for forgiveness.
The focus plural gathers the prior visible marks as the acknowledged material that detention must manage.
Confinement shifts suppression from the report to the bearer of the exculpatory signs.

changed_reading.after: The signs succeed in revealing innocence, and precisely for that reason their bearer becomes a liability to be hidden.
changed_reading.before: The signs are considered and then fail to prevent a mistaken punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Material inspection and testimony stabilize an exculpatory reading, but the immediate response is disengagement and covering; imprisonment extends that suppression from speech to the evidenced person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the evidence is inspected, yields a truth assignment, and is followed by an order to turn away. Reader: 12:35 extends that order into detention because exculpatory evidence threatens household control. Alternative: the signs may include the later bodily reactions, and prison may target scandal generally rather than the legal evidence alone.
structural_cues: 12:25-28 progresses from a directional tear to a conditional test, an explicit truth/lie result, and visual confirmation; 12:29 then orders disengagement rather than public correction.

activation_trace.role: Turning away supplies the first attempted strategy of ending attention without resolving it publicly.
Covering and protection give the attempted quieting a reputational as well as moral function.
Speech spreading among people demonstrates that the quieting attempt has failed.
Public renown turns a private event into a persistent social circulation problem.
Waiting for an opportune time makes detention a cooling strategy whose endpoint depends on changed conditions.
Physical confinement substitutes for the failed attempt to confine speech.

changed_reading.after: The duration is condition-sensitive: confinement buys time for public attention to decay after verbal suppression fails.
changed_reading.before: Until a time is an arbitrary or conventional sentence length.

context_deltas.mechanism: A command to turn aside and cover the matter fails when speech becomes city-wide and audible; the unnamed prison term becomes a cooling interval for an uncontained reputation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: attempted quieting is followed by wider speech and reaction. Reader: the unspecified term in 12:35 lasts until social attention cools. Alternative: the term may instead track coercive compliance, an administrative review, or an unstated release decision.
structural_cues: The order to disengage in 12:29 is immediately followed by city speech in 12:30 and a response to what has been heard in 12:31.

activation_trace.role: Widely circulating speech turns the household episode into a public narrative.
The gathered city expands the scale of concern from one household to a social field.
Renown among people supplies the transmission channel that prompts the staged response.
Being brought out from concealment makes visibility deliberately produced rather than accidental.
Mutual facing turns sight into a staged collective encounter whose effects can be compared.
Physical cutting leaves fresh bodily marks that can join the focus plural of visible signs.
Manifest marks can gather both juridical evidence and the visible bodily aftermath of collective seeing.
Confinement removes the recurrent object of public display from the network of sight and speech.

changed_reading.after: Prison quarantines visibility itself: it removes a person whose public appearance repeatedly generates marks, speech, and loss of control.
changed_reading.before: Prison hides an accused person after a private dispute.

context_deltas.mechanism: The scandal moves from city speech to a staged collective gaze that leaves bodily marks; prison quarantines the person whose repeated visibility produces socially contagious reactions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: public speech leads to staged viewing and visible bodily injury. Reader: those injuries belong among the plural signs, so detention controls repeat exposure. Alternative: the signs may refer narrowly to the shirt and testimony, while the spectacle only intensifies reputational pressure.
structural_cues: 12:30 publicizes the affair; 12:31 deliberately assembles viewers, commands emergence, records collective sight, and produces cut hands before the prison threat is restated in 12:32.

activation_trace.role: Demand and obligation make imprisonment the penalty attached to refusal of a command.
Confinement first enters as the coercer's explicit threatened sanction.
Abasement supplies the intended social meaning of that threatened sanction.
Protective holding frames refusal as active preservation rather than helpless noncompliance.
The same holding place is taken up in the threatened person's own comparison of outcomes.
Marked preference reverses prison's value from imposed shame to the more desirable of two constrained options.
Actual confinement preserves both incompatible readings: their coercive sanction and his chosen barrier.

changed_reading.after: The same prison is semantically contested, remaining their instrument of humiliation while becoming his material means of preserving refusal.
changed_reading.before: Prison has one stable meaning: punitive defeat imposed by those in power.

context_deltas.mechanism: The coercer couples prison to commanded compliance and humiliation, while the threatened person immediately prefers the same prison as the condition that preserves refusal; the focus therefore carries opposed valuations at once.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: one speaker threatens prison as abasement, and the threatened speaker prefers it to the invitation. Reader: his revaluation remains active when their decision is enacted. Alternative: 12:35 may foreground only the group's coercive intention even though the prior preference changes the reader's valuation.
structural_cues: 12:32 joins imprisonment to a command and humiliation; 12:33 immediately repeats prison in a first-person preference before 12:35 enacts it.

activation_trace.role: Preventive holding establishes protection from coercion as the live problem that prison may unexpectedly solve.
The holding place is explicitly preferred as one possible route away from the competing invitation.
Strong preference identifies confinement as an acceptable protective means rather than merely a feared outcome.
Turning something from its course names the requested directional change away from the coercive pressure.
A calculated stratagem identifies the hazard from which diversion is requested.
Response to speech marks the preceding appeal as answered rather than merely uttered.
Transfer from one condition to another states that the requested diversion has occurred.
The subsequent holding place can materialize the answered change by separating him from renewed access.

changed_reading.after: Without ceasing to be a human injustice, imprisonment may be the paradoxical medium through which the requested protection becomes durable.
changed_reading.before: The prison decision interrupts or contradicts the immediately preceding divine response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The requested diversion from a coercive plot is explicitly answered just before the human decision; imprisonment can therefore be read simultaneously as hostile agency and as the material route by which exposure is diverted.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the appeal, response, diversion, and later imprisonment are sequentially adjacent. Reader: the prison decision is one means through which the answered diversion takes durable form. Alternative: the answer may concern only immediate inward or situational protection, with imprisonment remaining a separate hostile act.
structural_cues: 12:33 prefers prison and asks for the plot to be turned away; 12:34 states response and diversion; 12:35 then reports the group's newly arising prison decision.

remaining_uncertainties: The plural signs may gather the torn garment and testimony, the women's bodily reactions, the broader sequence of proofs, or more than one of these.
It is uncertain whether the response and diversion in 12:34 include imprisonment as their durable means or end before the human decision in 12:35.
The group denoted by the plural decision and the condition that ends the unnamed time are not specified in the focus.
The deliberation and no-alternative outliers rely on form-distant mapped branches and must remain resonances rather than lexical claims.
strongest_changes: The signs do not merely fail to prevent prison; exculpatory visibility becomes a liability that prison suppresses.
Prison carries opposed values at once: coercive humiliation for those imposing it and protective refuge for the person confined.
The human decision can also function as the paradoxical material continuation of the immediately preceding answered diversion.
The unnamed term reads as strategic deferral or reputational cooling rather than a resolved verdict.
summary.what_was_special: The focus reverses the expected evidentiary arrow: seeing produces containment. Context preserves several mechanisms for that reversal without forcing a choice among evidence suppression, public-visibility quarantine, coercive punishment, protective refuge, answered diversion, and institutionalized enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Concealment begins a pattern in which visibility is controlled by assigning the person a manageable status.
A portion of wealth made into merchandise supplies the first explicit administrative recoding.
Exchange through sale moves the person between regimes of custody.
Taking and acquisition shifts the status from merchandise toward household incorporation.
Residence and settlement locate that new status within a household.
Institutional confinement recodes the same person again, now as a subject whose movement is suspended.

changed_reading.after: Imprisonment is the latest custody conversion in a sequence that moves him from hidden merchandise, to household acquisition, to immobilized institutional subject.
changed_reading.before: Imprisonment is an isolated punishment unrelated to the earlier economic narrative.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading links commercial, household, and carceral custody, so it is surprising and should not be rendered as lexical equivalence. It remains anchored in the focus act of confinement and in the repeated handling of the same person; downstream prose should call it a recurring social recoding rather than a hidden legal thesis.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The emphatic act of imprisoning him changes his administratively manageable status by immobilizing him.

activation_trace.role: Deliberation over an affair activates a review layer beneath the ordinary act of seeing.
The new opinion supplies the changed result of that possible review.
Direct visual inspection provides the concrete evidentiary event later subject to reconsideration.
Evaluative opinion shows that seeing in the sequence already moves between perception and judgment.
Collective facing adds a staged repetition of sight before the final policy shift.

changed_reading.after: The decision follows a chain of inspection, public evaluation, staged re-seeing, and reconsideration, with prison emerging after review rather than after one glance.
changed_reading.before: They see the signs once and then abruptly choose prison.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet's form-distant mapped branch from sight to deliberation, so it is too distant to replace the ordinary sense of seeing. It remains anchored in the focus perception clause and in repeated inspections and judgments; downstream prose should present it only as a resonance of review and reconsideration.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The combination of seeing the signs and a newly arising opinion can resonate with deliberation after review.

activation_trace.role: Inescapable necessity activates the possibility that the group presents its new policy as admitting no alternative.
A severity that fixes its object reinforces the rhetorical hardening from option into necessity.
Waiting for an unnamed time lets necessity remain in force without stating what could end it.

changed_reading.after: The group rhetorically converts its new option into an unavoidable necessity, even though the acknowledged signs should have opened alternatives.
changed_reading.before: A new policy option occurs to the group.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a form-distant activation from the packet's secondary mapping of the focus root, so it must not be translated as the clause's direct meaning. It remains anchored in the new-opinion verb and the emphatic prison construction; downstream prose should describe a resonance of manufactured necessity, not grammatical compulsion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A newly appearing collective opinion hardens immediately into an emphatic certainty of imprisonment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Visible signs generate a new policy without changing the facts.** ب د و B001/B003 (visible emergence; arising of a new opinion), ر ء ي B001, ء ي ي B003, and س ج ن B001 show decision following recognition. I infer that the signs establish innocence but also make confinement appear useful for containing scandal. The ayah reads as institutional management of known truth.
2. **Indefinite duration is part of the control.** ح ي ن B001/B004 (due occasion; staying for a while) leaves release uncalendared. I infer that uncertainty itself extends the prison’s force. `حتى حين` is temporal confinement as well as physical confinement.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:42 stretched حين into years, while 12:50-54 showed release arriving only after the signs were officially reopened.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A newly arising policy despite visible evidence.** `ب د و:B003` is “arising of a new opinion,” while `ب د و:B001` is visible emergence, including what is merely outwardly apparent in judgment. The ayah explicitly places their decision after seeing the signs; 12:30-32 supplies reputation pressure and an announced prison threat, while 12:36 shows the decision realized. The packet supplies evidence followed by policy; I infer that imprisonment answers social management needs rather than evidential uncertainty. *Badā lahum* therefore reads as a constructed change of mind that reveals how power can override what has appeared.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:50-54 finally lets the previously visible evidence govern policy and status, revealing this imprisonment as a temporary institutional override rather than the evidence's permanent defeat.

words.gloss_range: delayed sequence and narrative resumption after the prior protection scene
words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) does not make the decision feel immediate. It opens a delayed next beat after the protection of 12:34, so the reader feels a pause before the story turns from answered prayer to human confinement. Its doubled closing sound compresses that pause before the sudden appearance of the court's decision. The particle makes the prison decision a counter-expected sequel, not a seamless consequence of the signs.

topics.headline: delayed narrative reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a delayed reversal from divine protection in 12:34 to human decision-making in 12:35.
topics.reason: The conjunction marks sequence with distance, and the ayah then moves from prior protection into the prison resolution.

topics.headline: compressed pause in the opener
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening particle as a compact pause before the reversal lands.
topics.reason: The phonetic note adds a local cadence payoff to the delayed-sequence function.

words.gloss_range: completed emergence or seeming of a decision to the plural group, with the prison clause functioning as the appeared resolution
words.prose: {{ar:بَدَا}} ({{tr:badā}}) makes the imprisonment decision appear to the group as a completed resolution. The local idiom routes that appearing through the plural experiencers, while the delayed prison clause supplies what has appeared. The root's visibility field sharpens the irony: after visible signs, a human decision emerges that will hide Joseph in prison. The cadence releases from the delayed opener into the verb's open long vowel, matching the move from pause to emergence. Same-surah echoes deepen the turn, because this appearing recurs in a human-council pattern (12:77) and is later answered by Joseph's rescue memory from prison and open country (12:100).
words.root_gloss_range: visible emergence, outward appearing, new opinion, and open-country contrast; here the local idiom selects appearance or seeming to experiencers, not the open-country branch as the direct sense

topics.headline: appearance to experiencers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the decision is framed as something that appeared to them, not as neutral proof or direct divine judgment.
topics.reason: The local grammar gives the verb dative experiencers and lets the emphatic prison clause function as the appeared content.

topics.headline: visibility and seeming after signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the irony that visible evidence is followed by a merely human seeming that leads to concealment.
topics.reason: The visible-emergence and new-opinion pressures survive, while local grammar keeps the selected sense within the appearance-to-them idiom.

topics.headline: same-surah and cross-surah echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb belongs to a larger pattern of superficial seeing, human deliberation, prison, and later rescue memory.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete links with the same surah and with superficial sight language in 11:27, so the echo is preserved without making it control the local parse.

topics.headline: pause opening into appearance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the delayed opener move into an open-vowel verb as the decision emerges.
topics.reason: The sound note has a small but distinct payoff because it reinforces the transition from delayed sequence to appearing.

words.gloss_range: prepositional dative marking the plural group as experiencers of what appeared
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) makes the appearing belong to their viewpoint. It binds the following plural pronoun as a dative experiencer before the evidential phrase intervenes, so the reader does not hear the decision as objective necessity but as something that came to seem right to them.

topics.headline: dative experiencer viewpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the decision is grammatically routed through the group's perception.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the attached pronoun as the complement of the appearance verb.

topics.headline: viewpoint before evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees their viewpoint foregrounded before the sentence names the signs they had seen.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase comes before the after-seeing frame.

words.gloss_range: attached plural pronoun for an unnamed decision-making group
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) keeps the decision-makers plural but unnamed. The attached form distributes responsibility across a group rather than reducing it to one named figure, and the same plural line continues through the seeing and imprisoning actions. That chain makes the irony sharp: the one protected in 12:34 becomes the object of their confinement in 12:35.

topics.headline: unnamed plural agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that responsibility is spread across an unnamed group rather than lodged in a single named official.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies the suffix as an unnamed plural decision-making group and advises preserving that ambiguity.

topics.headline: pronoun chain into confinement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows one plural group from perception into action, while Joseph moves from protected referent in 12:34 to confined object in 12:35.
topics.reason: The same plural agency is recovered across the pronoun, the seeing verb, and the prison verb.

words.gloss_range: temporal source preposition making the seen signs the starting point after which the decision forms
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) opens the temporal hinge. It makes the decision arise from after the seen signs, so the evidence is not incidental background; it is the starting point from which the paradoxical prison decree follows. The nasal link into the following temporal noun lets the phrase feel compact while it turns proof into the origin of delay.

topics.headline: evidence as temporal origin
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prison decision begins after, and therefore despite, the witnessed signs.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the temporal noun and makes the after-seeing phrase the temporal source of the following decision.

topics.headline: nasal binding into the hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the temporal hinge as a compact bound phrase, not as a loose aside.
topics.reason: The sound observation reinforces the grammatical binding of the preposition to the temporal noun.

words.gloss_range: construct temporal afterness bound to the following seeing clause
words.prose: {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}) binds afterness to the whole seeing event. Its construct form makes the evidence clause the measure of what comes after, while the root's distance field makes the human judgment feel removed from the evidence it follows and anticipates Joseph being made distant through prison. The phrase forms the middle of the ayah: appearance before it, seen signs inside it, and prison decree after it. Cross-ayah parallels with after-evidence reversals such as 3:152, 4:153, and 2:211 keep that paradox visible without changing the local temporal parse.
words.root_gloss_range: distance, remoteness, after-ness, and removal; here temporal after is selected, with distance pressure sharpening the reversal from evidence

topics.headline: construct afterness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the seen signs become the exact event after which the decree takes shape.
topics.reason: The temporal noun is governed by the preceding preposition and governs the following clause as its content.

topics.headline: distance inside afterness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the judgment as temporally after the evidence and already leaning toward Joseph's imposed distance through prison.
topics.reason: The local sense is temporal after-ness, while the root's distance range adds image pressure rather than replacing the grammatical role.

topics.headline: after-evidence reversal network
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this phrase belongs to a wider Quranic pattern where response after evidence can become reversal rather than submission.
topics.reason: The supplied rows give concrete parallels at 3:152, 4:153, 2:211, and 12:100, so the inter-ayah payoff survives as a pattern rather than a local reparse.

topics.headline: compact temporal cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the temporal hinge as a compressed phrase carrying the narrative turn.
topics.reason: The cadence note adds a distinct local sound payoff to the temporal construction.

words.gloss_range: uninflected particle nominalizing or relating the seeing clause as the content governed by after
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) turns the seeing into the complement of the after-phrase. Its surface can be heard as the act of their seeing or as what they saw, so the evidence pressure is doubled without changing the syntax: both the witnessing event and the witnessed content stand inside the temporal hinge.

topics.headline: embedded evidence clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the evidence clause is embedded inside the temporal frame, not stated as an independent aside.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes the particle and following verb-object clause the content governed by the temporal noun.

topics.headline: act and content both live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel both the act of seeing and the seen signs as the basis for the paradoxical decision.
topics.reason: The particle supports nominalizing and relative readings while the local syntax keeps both within the after-clause.

words.gloss_range: completed plural seeing or witnessing of the signs, with judgment pressure present but local grammar selecting direct perception
words.prose: {{ar:رَأَوُا}} ({{tr:raʾawu}}) fixes the signs as already witnessed by the same plural group. The verb takes the signs as its direct object, so the evidence is physically acquired before the prison decision is voiced. The root's judgment and vision range adds pressure: this is not ignorance, but failed human seeing after proof. Its recitation variant changes the acoustic contour without changing the completed sight payoff. The surah's sight network makes the failure sharper, moving from Joseph's dream (12:4) through public testimony (12:51) toward prison vision in 12:36, while rejection-after-seeing parallels such as 7:146 keep the moral pattern in view.
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, considering, judging, and visionary seeing; here a completed plural act of witnessing with judgment overtones constrained by the direct object

topics.headline: completed plural witnessing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group had already seen the signs before resolving on prison.
topics.reason: The perfect plural verb takes the signs as object and shares the plural subject recovered elsewhere in the sentence.

topics.headline: sight and judgment pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels a collision between physical sight and failed judgment.
topics.reason: The local direct object selects seeing or witnessing, while the root's consider-judge range survives as interpretive pressure.

topics.headline: sight network and rejection pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects failed public seeing in 12:35 with the surah's broader movement from dreams to testimony to prison visions.
topics.reason: The supplied rows name concrete links including 12:4, 12:36, 12:43, 12:51, 12:100, 7:146, and 42:44.

topics.headline: evidence pivot and recitation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the seeing verb pivot the sentence from proof toward the prison decree.
topics.reason: The verb-object phrase forms the embedded proof before the emphatic prison clause, and the variant note affects recitation contour without changing the local sense.

words.gloss_range: definite plural signs or evidences directly witnessed in the scene
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْءَايَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-āyāti}}) names the object of their seeing as known signs, not vague information. Its marked stop-and-length contour arrests the flow at the proof word just before the emphatic prison decision. Its definiteness and plurality make the evidence already identifiable and multiple. The sign word carries both public proof and divine indication, so the decision to imprison after seeing it becomes a refusal of what the signs disclose. The same-surah frame matters: 12:7 calls Joseph's story signs for those who ask, while 12:35 shows signs seen by actors who answer with confinement; parallels such as 6:25 and 10:21 preserve that rejection-after-signs pressure.
words.root_gloss_range: sign, mark, proof, wonder, and indication; here known evidentiary signs are selected, with broader divine-sign pressure still active

topics.headline: definite plural object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the seen evidence is definite and multiple, not vague rumor.
topics.reason: The noun is the direct object of the seeing verb and is marked as definite plural.

topics.headline: proof-bearing sign pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the signs as both evidence in the case and indications that point beyond the surface event.
topics.reason: The local noun remains signs or evidences, while broader proof-bearing and divine-sign pressure survives as the word's semantic force.

topics.headline: signs seen and resisted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the seen signs in 12:35 to the story's announced signs in 12:7 and to wider patterns of signs being resisted.

topics.headline: proof before prison decision

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) pivots the sentence from evidence to decree. It fastens assertion onto the prison verb, and together with the heavy emphasis later in the verb it makes the resolution sound committed rather than tentative.
